title: Capstone release review
outcome: Explain capstone release review using the deciding step in this fictional service.
scenario: Review every mandatory gate. A capstone release needs factual, access and deletion gates to pass.
given: Factual and access checks pass. Deletion fails because a listed backup remains. All three gates are mandatory.

steps.label: List evidence
steps.detail: Record two passes and the specific deletion failure.

steps.label: Apply decision rule
steps.detail: Block release; a majority of passes is insufficient.

steps.label: Specify repair
steps.detail: Remove the listed copy and verify it before a fresh review.

explanation: Release review applies explicit conditions to a specific candidate version. Completed coding is not evidence that all operational obligations are satisfied.

counterfactual.change: Every listed deletion location passes new verification.
counterfactual.prediction: That gate can pass; review the complete current evidence before approving release.
counterfactual.reason: One repaired gate does not automatically refresh evidence for every other gate.

student_task: Apply the three mandatory release gates to the recorded results. Why do two passes not outweigh the deletion failure, and what evidence must follow its repair?
teacher_answer: Record two passes and the specific deletion failure. Block release; a majority of passes is insufficient. Remove the listed copy and verify it before a fresh review. Changed case: That gate can pass; review the complete current evidence before approving release. One repaired gate does not automatically refresh evidence for every other gate.
project_evidence: For the Grounded Learning Service, retain an annotated trace and the changed-case result. Name the contract or evidence that makes the deciding step valid, so another team can review it.
limits: Approval cannot guarantee zero future faults; retain ownership, monitoring and recovery arrangements.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice, distinct from the reserved independent case. These stipulated records illustrate reasoning; no real service execution or learner outcome is claimed.
